correctness.rationale: The stationary joint occupied-probability row q obeys q=(qD+pi diag(c))P, so U(P)=pi diag(c)(I-PD)^-1 1, with ||PD||infty<1 since 0<c_i,s_i<1; uniqueness and convergence of the resolvent do not require aperiodicity. The reversed chain has the same positive determinant because D commutes with Pi and det(I-AB)=det(I-BA). Write the stationary edge flow Pi P as symmetric pair flows h_ij plus signed cyclic current J/2. Independently constructed symbolic 3x3 matrices and verified identically, not by parameter sampling, that the adjugate numerator difference is J times c1(d2-d3)+c2(d3-d1)+c3(d1-d2); substituting d=s-c cancels the pure-c area and yields the stated oriented (c,s) area. A positive denominator makes the sign and iff criterion exact. A two-state stationary chain satisfies detailed balance automatically. Rechecked the given rational six-state example P,pi,c,s, with J=1/25, area=7/100, det=6287/20000 and difference=56/6287; source random 50 tests are only supplementary.
